verdict.rationale: Sift exposes a broad programmatic surface. It has REST Events, Decisions, Score and Workflows APIs plus mobile SDKs and a JS snippet. Through these, data ingestion, backfill, custom events, risk scores and decisions can all be driven by API. However, nothing in the evidence shows that UI-side functions have API equivalents, such as building Workflows, configuring custom Decisions and working Review Queues. Those appear only as guided setup tasks. Missing for 10: documented API parity for workflow and rule creation, Review Queue and manual-review operations via API, any statement or independent confirmation that everything in the UI is available through the API.
